claim_text: Jacob Spence, director of Marion County Emergency Management, called the flooding a once-in-a-lifetime type flood, telling The Associated Press that it was an unprecedented event in which the state was setting new records.
quote: "This is an unprecedented event, and unfortunately we're setting some new records," he told The Associated Press.
confidence_justification: Direct quote from a named emergency management official, but it is a characterisation of severity rather than a measured figure.
